clean.description: Starts a cleaning run with the selected rooms, mode, coverage, and order.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: At most 100 room names or stable room IDs in the desired order. Omit this field to use the robot's clean-all command.

cleaning_mode.name: Cleaning mode
cleaning_mode.description: Cleaning system for this run. Omit it to use Default cleaning mode.

coverage_setting.name: Vacuum coverage
coverage_setting.description: Vacuum coverage for this run. Omit it to use Default vacuum coverage. Does not change mopping; use the robot's Double-pass mopping setting for an extra mop pass.

ordered.name: Clean in order
ordered.description: Clean rooms in the supplied order.

intelligent_clean.name: Intelligent cleaning
intelligent_clean.description: Starts with the room least recently confirmed as the current cleaning area, then continues until stopped or every selected room finishes. Rejected commands and lingering prior-room state do not change priority; rooms that started remain due without monopolizing later runs.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or stable ID. Omit it to use the default plan.

clean_entire_plan.name: Clean entire plan
clean_entire_plan.description: Runs the default or named plan once from top to bottom, using each room's saved settings.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or stable ID. Omit it to use the default plan.

run_selected_plan.name: Run plan with saved behavior
run_selected_plan.description: Runs the default or named plan using its saved cleaning behavior.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or stable ID. Omit it to use the default plan.

preview_token.name: Preview token
preview_token.description: Use the token returned by preview_plan to run the accepted saved-plan resolution.

preview_plan.name: Preview next plan run
preview_plan.description: Shows which rooms the next plan run would clean without starting the robot or changing history.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or stable ID. Omit it to use the default plan.

stop_intelligent_cleaning.name: Stop cleaning plan
stop_intelligent_cleaning.description: Stops the plan using its saved finish-current-room policy, never starts another room, and sends the robot to its dock.

include_unmanaged.name: Also stop other cleaning
include_unmanaged.description: If no managed plan is running, stop one-time or externally started cleaning and return to the dock. Active plans always use their saved stop policy.

expected_run_id.name: Expected run ID
expected_run_id.description: Optional run ID from plan diagnostics. Stop is rejected if that managed run is no longer active.

reset_plan_history.name: Reset cleaning history
reset_plan_history.description: Clears room completion history without deleting plans or room settings.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or stable ID. Omit it to use the default plan.

all_plans.name: Reset history for every plan
all_plans.description: Clear intelligent-cleaning history for every plan.

reset_room_cadence.name: Reset room schedule progress
reset_room_cadence.description: Resets the selected cadence progress and one-time due settings without changing cleaning history. Omit modes to reset both mopping and coverage.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Plan name or stable ID containing the room.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: Stable room ID to reset. Omit this field to reset every scheduled room in the plan.

modes.name: Cadence types
modes.description: Reset mopping, coverage, or both. Omit this field to reset both.

list_plans.name: List cleaning plans
list_plans.description: Returns saved plans, rooms, room settings, IDs, and the default plan.

save_plan.name: Create or replace cleaning plan
save_plan.description: Creates a plan or replaces an existing plan with the same ID.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: Stable ID to replace; omit to derive it from the name.

run_behavior.name: Cleaning order
run_behavior.description: Intelligent rotation uses target-room-confirmed cleaning starts and shared opportunity history; saved order breaks ties. Rejected commands and lingering prior-room state do not change priority. Run all cleans every selected room from top to bottom.

rooms.name: Rooms and settings
rooms.description: Ordered mapped rooms with individual cleaning mode and coverage settings.

return_to_base.name: Return to dock when finished
return_to_base.description: Send the robot to its dock after all selected rooms finish successfully.

finish_current_room.name: Finish the current room when stopping
finish_current_room.description: Allow the active room to finish when its estimated progress meets the threshold. The next room never starts.

finish_current_room_threshold.name: Finish-room progress threshold
finish_current_room_threshold.description: Below this estimated percentage, stop immediately. At or above it, finish the room. The estimate learns from successful managed runs with the same room settings.

select.name: Use as default plan
select.description: Use this plan when an action does not name one.

start_timeout.name: Start timeout
start_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each room to start cleaning.

completion_timeout.name: Room completion timeout
completion_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for each room to finish.

delete_plan.name: Delete cleaning plan
delete_plan.description: Deletes one plan by stable ID or exact name.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Stable plan ID or exact name.

select_plan.name: Set default cleaning plan
select_plan.description: Sets the plan used when an action, entity, or button does not name one.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Stable plan ID or exact name.

save_plan_room.name: Add or update plan room
save_plan_room.description: Adds one mapped room or updates that room's individual settings.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Stable plan ID or exact name.

room.name: Room and settings
room.description: Mapped room name or stable room ID with its cleaning mode and coverage setting. Stable IDs take precedence.

delete_plan_room.name: Remove room from plan
delete_plan_room.description: Removes one mapped room and its settings from a plan.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Stable plan ID or exact name.

room.name: Room
room.description: Mapped room name or stable room ID. Stable IDs take precedence.

move_plan_room.name: Move room in plan
move_plan_room.description: Changes one mapped room's saved position.

plan.name: Cleaning plan
plan.description: Stable plan ID or exact name.

room.name: Room
room.description: Mapped room name or stable room ID. Stable IDs take precedence.

new_position.name: New position
new_position.description: New position in the room list, where 1 is the top.

inspect_hermes_endpoint.name: Inspect Hermes endpoint
inspect_hermes_endpoint.description: Reads payload-free sizes and SHA-256 fingerprints from a supported local Hermes endpoint. Credential endpoints are blocked.

endpoint.name: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Local Hermes property or collection to inspect.

firmware_snapshot.name: Firmware snapshot
firmware_snapshot.description: Checks every known non-credential Hermes endpoint, stores a payload-free compatibility record, and reports availability, content, and value-free wire-shape changes from the prior snapshot.

firmware_investigator.name: Set firmware investigator
firmware_investigator.description: Assign firmware research to any connected agent without changing robot controls. Switching invalidates active claims and preserves evidence. Administrator access is required.

provider.name: Investigator
provider.description: A lowercase name such as openclaw, dot, or bot. Use manual to stop automatic claims. The named agent must be connected separately.

firmware_notification.name: Update firmware notification
firmware_notification.description: Acknowledge a current report, record accepted notification delivery, or request a bounded read-only recheck. Used by the Firmware intelligence blueprint.

report_id.name: Report ID
report_id.description: The current report ID from the Firmware compatibility sensor.

action.name: Action
action.description: Acknowledge, mark delivered, or request a recheck.
